card.text: M46 is an open star cluster in the Milky Way, about 1,555 parsecs away.

sources.quote: Messier 46 or M46, also known as NGC 2437, is an open cluster of stars in the slightly southern constellation of Puppis.

introduction.text: M46 is drawn as 1,657 of its member stars, measured by Gaia; each dot sits at its sky position, at the cluster's distance.
